title: Junk Dropper
description: Best mod for cleaning for servers
body:
Tired of messy inventories during intense PvP fights?
This mod is designed to keep your inventory clean, fast, and battle-ready.

With a single key press, the mod automatically drops all unnecessary items from your inventory while keeping important PvP items safe.

⚔️ Protected PvP Items

The following items will NOT be dropped:

XP Bottles

Totems of Undying

Netherite Sword

Axe

Shield

Armor (all pieces)

Ender Pearls

Golden Apples

Potions

Everything else gets dropped instantly, helping you focus only on the fight.

⌨️ Custom Keybind

Fully customizable keybind

Change the key anytime from Minecraft Controls settings

🚀 Why use this mod?

Perfect for PvP In the servers 

Saves time during fights

No more manual inventory cleaning

Simple, lightweight, and efficient

Press one button.
Clean inventory.
Dominate the fight. 💀🔥
